info.title: COTA API Documentation
info.description: API documentation for COTA - Smart Fish Feeding System. This API provides endpoints for managing fish pond feeding schedules, monitoring sensor data, and handling user authentication.

post.description: Register a new user account with email, password, and profile information
Authenticate user with email and password, and generate access token
Invalidate the current user authentication token

get.description: Trigger manual feeding (not related to any schedule)
Trigger manual execution of a specific feed schedule
Get all feed schedules that are ready to execute (within the last minute)
Retrieve complete history of all feed executions including scheduled and manual feeds, ordered by execution time
Check the status of recent feed execution (for polling)
Get a list of all feed schedules for the authenticated user, including recent execution history
Get detailed information about a specific feed schedule including statistics and execution history

put.description: Update an existing feed schedule with new settings (all fields are optional)

delete.description: Delete an existing feed schedule permanently

post.description: Create a new automated feeding schedule with customizable frequency and time settings

patch.description: Activate a feed schedule to enable automatic feeding
Deactivate a feed schedule to disable automatic feeding

get.description: Get all currently active feed schedules for the authenticated user
Retrieve all notifications for the authenticated user with pagination support

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of notifications to return

get.description: Retrieve only unread notifications for the authenticated user

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of unread notifications to return

get.description: Get statistics about user notifications including total, read, and unread counts

post.description: Mark a specific notification as read
Mark all notifications for the authenticated user as read

200.description: All notifications marked as read successfully

post.description: Create a new fish pond with auto-generated token

put.description: Update pond information (only owner can update)

delete.description: Delete pond permanently (only owner can delete)

post.description: Insert new sensor reading data. Supports both real-time and delayed data. Normalizes invalid values automatically.

get.description: Retrieve the most recent sensor reading
Retrieve historical sensor data with advanced filtering, pagination, and aggregation options. Supports time-based queries, cursor pagination, and granularity control.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Get data from last N minutes (mutually exclusive with from/to)

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of metrics to return

304.description: Not Modified (cached data is still valid)

get.description: Get statistics about sensor data quality including real-time vs estimated records, and data gaps

401.description: Unauthorized - Token tidak valid atau expired

put.description: Update authenticated user's profile information (partial update supported)

401.description: Unauthorized - Token tidak valid atau expired

delete.description: Permanently delete authenticated user's account with password confirmation

401.description: Unauthorized - Wrong password or invalid token

is_active.description: Schedule active status (optional, defaults to true)
